description: This file provides support for Protocol Buffers extensions in Go, including types, interfaces, and functions for managing extensions within protobuf messages, such as registering, checking, setting, getting, and clearing extensions.

classes.name: extensionAdapter
classes.description: Wrapper around extendableProtoV1 to implement extendableProto interface.

classes.name: XXX_InternalExtensions
classes.description: Internal representation of protobuf extensions, managing extension maps with concurrency control.

classes.name: ExtensionDesc
classes.description: Descriptor for a protobuf extension, including type info, field number, name, and file info.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Represents an extension in a protobuf message, including description, value, and encoded bytes.

methods.name: extensionsWrite
methods.description: Returns the extension map, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: extensionsRead
methods.description: Returns the extension map for read-only access along with its mutex.

methods.name: repeated
methods.description: Determines if the extension type is a repeated field.
